plan.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Build sustained damage, upgrade Neutralize, and retain strong block for the explosion after defeating the Giant. Enter with healthy HP and useful potions.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage early, then add poison scaling, dexterity, and draw. Remove basics once replacements exist. Fight elites with adequate HP and potions; balance healing with core upgrades.

plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Recover HP, add sustained poison and stronger block, upgrade weakness when safe, and save defensive resources for the Giant’s post-kill explosion.
plan.summary: Heal urgently and avoid optional elites. Stop adding marginal attacks; prioritize defense and sustained poison. Remove Strikes, preserve basic block until replaced, and upgrade weakness when recovery permits.
